newsitem.title: CHINA: Macau trial run for Asiana 747 freighter.
newsitem.headline: Macau trial run for Asiana 747 freighter.

text.p: Asiana Airlines is flying four unscheduled Boeing 747-400 freighters into Macau from Seoul to test the market for further development, a Hong Kong based Asiana spokesman told Reuters.
The carrier already operates 767-300 freighters into the Portuguese enclave twice weekly from Seoul.
"We have operated two extra 747 flights during July and will have another two during August as a test case to assess the market and demand," the spokesman said.

Asiana is keeping a close eye on the overall rate between Hong Kong and Seoul via Macou which includes barge fees for shipping from a major marketplace such as Hong Kong to Macau airport, the spokesman said.
Meanwhile, rivals Korean Airlines has denied reports that it will be joining Asiana in Macau.

"Even on a long term basis we don't have any plans at the moment to operate into Macau," said Ji Young Lee, KAL's cargo marketing vice president and general manager frequencies. KAL operates a twice weekly Airbus A300 freighter into Shenzhen airport in China's Guangdong province.

A senior KAL spokesman recently said the Shenzhen service is not profitable and difficulties with customs clearance at the China/Hong Kong border is hampering efficiency but Lee said KAL is committed to Shenzhen and has plans to start a third weekly frequency "sooner or later."
